title: Any window size
description:
Draw a game made for 320x180 on any window, keeping the shape, with black bars.

```
window 1280x720  -> scale 4, offset (0, 0)
window 1366x768  -> scale 4 (whole numbers only), offset (43, 24)
window 1920x1200 -> scale 6, offset (0, 60)
mouse (700, 400) in 1366x768 -> game (164, 94)
```
hints: `scale = std::max(1, std::min(windowW / gameW, windowH / gameH))` and `offsetX = (windowW - gameW * scale) / 2` (lesson 1.03).
Game x is `(mouseX - offsetX) / scale`; outside 0..gameW means a bar.
requirements: The scale is the largest whole number that fits both sides.
Centre the game picture in the window.
Convert mouse positions from window to game coordinates, and say when the mouse is on a bar.
stretch: Allow non-whole scales as an option, and compare how pixel art looks.
